public_rationale: The claim concerns a test of about 45 minutes that Marcus's post says Reid Southen ran with Midjourney images. The only record of that test is the speaker's own post, and that cannot count as evidence that he was right. The evidence packet has no independent record of the test and no reproduction using the same images. AI Snake Oil's post, available 2024-01-23 (e1), reports that ChatGPT-4 recognized all nine images from an earlier Marcus and Southen article. That fits the statement that ChatGPT 'nailed some images'. But those were different images, so e1 says nothing about the harder cases in the claimed test. The evidence neither confirms nor contradicts the claim that ChatGPT's performance in that test was intermittent.
limitations: The packet has no independent record of the images Southen tested or of ChatGPT's answers to them.
The AI Snake Oil test (e1) used a different set of images, so its results do not carry over to the claimed test.
'Pretty intermittent' has no threshold, so it is unclear how many failures would count.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: In a 45-minute test, multimodal ChatGPT was unreliable at identifying the copyrighted sources of Midjourney-generated images.

statement.excerpt: Reid spent about 45 minutes looking into this earlier today (why not more? see below) with images generated by Midjourney, and it quickly became apparent that using ChatGPT as intern to trace down sources is, well, pretty intermittent.
statement.document_title: No, multimodal ChatGPT is not going to “trivially” solve Generative AI's copyright problems

from_speaker: using ChatGPT as intern to trace down sources is ... pretty intermittent
our_interpretation: Plain reading: in an informal test of about 45 minutes on 2024-01-24, ChatGPT correctly identified the sources of some Midjourney images but missed or gave vague answers on others.
Settling this needs independent records of the test or a faithful reproduction. The speaker's own screenshots cannot count as evidence that he was right.
criteria.support_condition: Independent records or a reproduction from that time show ChatGPT getting some Midjourney image sources right and failing on others.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Independent records or a reproduction show ChatGPT consistently identifying the sources of the images tested.
